description_en: Queries the generation status (not generated, generating, or generated) and generation information of a report for a specified validation batch
description_zh: 查询指定校验批次报告的生成状态（未生成、生成中、已生成）及报告生成信息
name: GetDataCheckReportStatus

parameters.help_en: The batch ID returned by the ExecDataCheckSaveTask operation
parameters.name: batch_id

data.description_en:
The report generation status. Valid values:

0: not generated
1: generating
2: generated
3: generation failed
data.description_zh: 报告生成状态：0-未生成 1-生成中 2-已生成 3-生成失败
data.title_en: 报告生成状态：0-未生成 1-生成中 2-已生成 3-生成失败
data.title_zh: 报告生成状态：0-未生成 1-生成中 2-已生成 3-生成失败

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues with this call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed. Check errCode and errMessage for troubleshooting
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
